facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports that on 2 September 2025 President Mahama told the Lands Commission to integrate services across its Registries, Valuation and Survey departments, building on the enterprise land information system; in-service use of the system is not stated.

Ghana News Agency reports that on 2 September 2025 President Mahama tasked the Lands Commission to digitise all land records nationwide, building on the enterprise land information system, and to open land offices in all 261 district assemblies.

GHA.note: Land offices in district assemblies are directed, but nothing is stated on the assemblies' office connection.
